sources.snippet: OpenAI Whisper speech recognition models, exported to to ONNX using the Whisper ONNX Exporter tool. Each model tarball includes an encoder.onnx and decoder.onnx model files. They are mainly intended to be used from Echogarden, but can also be used from other applications. All models except large, large-v1 and large-v2 are available. sources.title: whisper-base.en: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-base.en is an English-only automatic speech recognition model built by openai that transcribes spoken English audio to text. It is a Transformer-based encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) model with 74 million parameters trained on 680,000 hours of labeled speech data using large-scale weak supervision. The model works with the WhisperProcessor from the transformers library ...
